title: BibSonomy - The blue social bookmark and publication sharing system.

description.en: BibSonomy is a social bookmarking system. The dataset contains user-generated metadata about web pages and scholarly publications, specifically, tags, that is, freely chosen keywords.  BibSonomy provides metadata to web pages using owl:sameAs links as well links to DBLP.
